Hossainabad runners ~280-330 cm: Armitage range $300-$470 typical (median about $320, one $930 outlier); Gowans Hamadan runners $200-$450. No resale comps in databases.

viewing_check: Check the back for hand-knotted (visible knots, not machine), pile wear and moth damage, stains or pet odour, fringe/selvedge repairs, dye run in the red, exact size and whether it lies flat.
